response.sql: WITH humidity_by_equip AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipref), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(humepct) as global_avg FROM scanenvironment WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL), above_avg AS (SELECT h.equipref, h.avg_humidity, o.global_avg FROM humidity_by_equip h CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE h.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL AND o.global_avg IS NOT NULL AND h.avg_humidity > o.global_avg), group_stats AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as above_group_avg FROM above_avg) SELECT a.equipref, a.avg_humidity, a.avg_humidity - a.global_avg as exceeds_overall, a.avg_humidity - gs.above_group_avg as exceeds_group_mean FROM above_avg a CROSS JOIN group_stats gs ORDER BY exceeds_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The 'average across all equipment' is the global mean of all humidity readings (weighted by reading count per equipment), not the unweighted mean of per-equipment average humidity values. This affects whether equipment with many readings vs. few readings pull the baseline average more heavily.

alternatives.interpretation: The 'average across all equipment' refers to the unweighted mean of per-equipment averages—each equipment contributes equally regardless of how many humidity measurements it has.
